items.headline: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for discovering cosmic neutrinos with a telescope built into Antarctic ice
items.summary: Francis Halzen won the twenty twenty six Nobel Prize in Physics for leading the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, which detected high energy neutrinos coming from deep space. The find opened an entirely new way to observe the universe, using nearly massless particles instead of light.
items.why_it_matters: Confirming that neutrinos reach Earth from distant cosmic sources gives astronomers a verified new window on the universe, independent of ordinary telescopes.
